result.title: HumanPhys: A Human-Centric Physical-World Perception Benchmark for Real-World Visual Reasoning
result.summary: We introduce HumanPhys, a human-centric benchmark for real-world physical perception, and a training corpus emitted by the same pipeline. Each question targets a physically grounded quantity related to people, including depth, inter-person distance, gaze angle, displacement, velocity, heading-step trajectory, blink count, and contact-deformation strength. The rendered probes additionally test illumination inference from body and face cues and camera ego-motion, both with and without a person in the frame. All labels are derived programmatically from sensor calibration, source metadata, or renderer state, rather than written by annotators or produced by estimators on the benchmark frames. HumanPhys systematically probes six dimensions of human-centric physical perception: spatial state, kinematics, blink events, deformation, illumination, and camera pose. To the best of our knowledge, no existing MLLM benchmark-and-training corpus jointly supervises this set of human-centered physical quantities under direct metadata- or renderer-derived labels. The six dimensions appear only partially dissociable across the tested MLLMs. We benchmark a range of open- and closed-source MLLMs on HumanPhys and find that all six capability dimensions remain challenging for current models. We hope HumanPhys will support future research on multimodal systems that perceive and reason about people in the physical world.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HumanPhys，一个以人为中心的真实世界物理感知基准及同流程生成的训练语料，题目覆盖深度、人际距离、视线角、位移速度、轨迹、眨眼、形变、光照与相机自运动等物理量，标签由传感器标定、元数据或渲染器状态程序化导出，并在六个维度上评测多家开源与闭源 MLLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 其物理量标签与六维诊断可用于核查 VLM 是否在内部状态中保留几何、深度与运动等任务必要视觉信息，属主线关心的表示与诊断资源；但论文未涉及 latent 推理状态生成，能否支撑内部表示层面的因果分析需进一步核查。
